title: AI-Generated Images Discourage Me from Reading Your Blog
titleZh: 人工智能生成的图像阻止我阅读你的博客
author: meysamazad
relevanceReason: 命中 3 个 AI/科技关键词。
summaryRaw: I have a growing hatred for AI-generated images in blogs. It makes me wonder if the text in the blog posts is AI-generated to some extent. It’s always disappointing seeing these images in blogs run by individuals. I expect this from corporate blogs but not indie blogs.I’d rather see a shitty Microsoft Paint drawing as opposed to some AI image.I know there are plenty of things you can roast my blog for but at least you know for a fact you’re getting the thoughts of a real human being and not some LLM.If you run a personal blog, please avoid AI-generated images.Discussion over at Hacker News

comments.author: zmmmmm
comments.textRawHtml:
To me there are different motivations to include imagery and some of them are just fine with AI generation. If the imagery actually goes to the substance of helping to illustrate or explain the actual content then it seems very superficial to reject it based on how it was generated. In fact it is kind of stupid to insist someone slavishly draw something by hand that could have been done an easier way.

The problem comes when the imagery is placed as a false value signal. If it is designed to send a signal of "this content took a lot of effort to produce because an image that would be hard for a human to make is attached to it" - but the image was generated without that effort, then it's basically a lie and insult to the reader.
comments.textZhHtml:
对我来说，包含图像有不同的动机，其中一些对于人工智能生成来说是很好的。如果图像实际上有助于说明或解释实际内容，那么根据它的生成方式来拒绝它似乎是非常肤浅的。事实上，坚持某人盲目地手绘一些本来可以用更简单的方法完成的东西是有点愚蠢的。

当图像被放置为错误的价值信号时，问题就出现了。如果它的目的是发出这样的信号：“该内容花了很多精力来制作，因为上面附加了人类难以制作的图像” - 但该图像是在没有付出这种努力的情况下生成的，那么它基本上是对读者的谎言和侮辱。

children.author: bonoboTP
children.textRawHtml:
It's like styrofoam stucco on the ceiling.

Decoration and ornament have served always to signal extra effort that went into something, signaling that it is considered important and valued by the maker/owner. But people also have incentive to do cheaper mimicry. And then the viewers have incentive to distinguish real from fake to see where true, scarce effort went. These dynamics are crucial for understanding the feelings and emotions around AI. Value is almost never in the thing itself or some inherent quality but in the social signals and relationships. (somewhat less true in very utilitarian engineering machinery or for sustenance level basic necessities).
children.textZhHtml:
就像天花板上的聚苯乙烯泡沫塑料灰泥。

装饰和装饰品始终表明对某些事物付出了额外的努力，表明它被制造商/所有者认为是重要和重视的。但人们也有动机进行更便宜的模仿。然后观众就有动力去区分真假，看看真正的、稀缺的努力去了哪里。这些动态对于理解人工智能周围的感受和情绪至关重要。价值几乎从来不在于事物本身或某些内在品质，而在于社会信号和关系。 （对于非常实用的工程机械或维持生计水平的基本必需品来说，情况有些不太正确）。

children.author: Gigachad
children.textRawHtml:
In a blog, real images signify you spent a lot of time creating the post, it was very important to you, and you likely made sure the details in the text were accurate.

While AI images in a blog signify low effort high volume posting where the text likely was just copied from AI without any care.
children.textZhHtml:
在博客中，真实图像意味着您花费了大量时间来创建帖子，这对您来说非常重要，并且您可能确保文本中的详细信息准确无误。

博客中的 AI 图像意味着轻松大量发布，其中文本可能只是从 AI 中毫不关心地复制而来。

children.author: bonoboTP
children.textRawHtml: The article author should have specified more closely which type of image. Stock image sites had already made generic photos and drawings cheap to include. And indeed they look cheap. The more airbrushed and high quality the cheaper it looks. If a dentist website has cheap beautiful stock nurse photos, it's less valued than real photos taken by a photographer at their location.
children.textZhHtml: 文章作者应该更仔细地指定图像类型。库存图片网站已经使通用照片和图画的价格变得便宜。事实上，它们看起来很便宜。喷漆越多、质量越高，它看起来就越便宜。如果牙医网站上有廉价的美丽护士照片，那么它的价值就低于摄影师在其所在地拍摄的真实照片。

children.author: PaulHoule
children.textRawHtml: Once in a while you get a good one, one that stands out among all the others, and that's a worse outcome because the same image will be used by everybody including your competitors.
children.textZhHtml: 偶尔你会得到一张好的图片，一张在所有其他图片中脱颖而出的图片，但这是一个更糟糕的结果，因为同一张图片会被每个人使用，包括你的竞争对手。

children.author: ToucanLoucan
children.textRawHtml:
It's hard to articulate this stuff, and especially hard to explain it to the AI infatuated among us because they don't really want to understand why people dislike the tooling they're obsessed with. AI is good at many things, digesting vast quantities of information, and code being most of them. Everything else to me looks/sounds like shit. AI music sounds dull and overproduced in a way that a lot of middling pop music does. AI images look overtuned and strange in the same way a magazine editor would, if they had no self control with their tools. It just... looks bad. As an aesthetic. If you are not aesthetically minded, you may not care, or you may not be able to tell, and that's fine. But I am and I can and if I open your blog post and see AI crap, I'm leaving. I'm not asking anyone else to, and I don't give a shit if my best friend in the world wants to beat his meat to your AI generated sunset, good for him, I hope he has a great time. But I'm not interested.

Why these super-pro-AI people take this as such a personal slight is strange to me. You didn't care enough to actually make something, what are you offended if I tell you I don't really want to look at it?
children.textZhHtml:
很难清楚地表达这些东西，尤其是很难向我们中间迷恋的人工智能解释它，因为他们并不真正想理解为什么人们不喜欢他们所痴迷的工具。人工智能擅长很多事情，消化大量信息，其中大部分是代码。对我来说，其他一切看起来/听起来都像狗屎。人工智能音乐听起来沉闷且制作过度，就像许多中等流行音乐一样。人工智能图像看起来过度调整和奇怪，就像杂志编辑一样，如果他们对工具没有自我控制的话。只是……看起来很糟糕。作为一种审美。如果你没有审美意识，你可能不会在意，或者你可能无法分辨，那也没关系。但我是，而且我可以，如果我打开你的博客文章并看到人工智能垃圾，我就会离开。我不会要求其他人这样做，如果我世界上最好的朋友想在你的人工智能生成的日落中击败他的肉，我也不在乎，这对他有好处，我希望他玩得很开心。但我不感兴趣。

为什么这些超级支持人工智能的人会认为这是对我个人的侮辱，这对我来说很奇怪。你并没有足够关心去真正制作一些东西，如果我告诉你我真的不想看它，你有什么生气吗？

children.author: bonoboTP
children.textRawHtml:
The tools are getting better and often that overproduced thing is the toupee effect, where you don't notice the better ones. The generic look can be avoided with more customized prompting. You can make much more natural songs with longer prompts, a bit of quickly self-sung melodies you add as references, even if you can't sing. Similarly for images, sketching something out in paint can make a huge difference or just iterating 2 or 3 times and not accepting the first result.

And the tools are going to get better too.
children.textZhHtml:
这些工具正在变得越来越好，而且通常过度生产的东西就是假发效果，您不会注意到更好的工具。通过更多定制的提示可以避免通用的外观。即使您不会唱歌，您也可以通过更长的提示、添加一些快速自唱的旋律作为参考来制作更自然的歌曲。类似地，对于图像来说，在油漆中勾勒出一些东西可以产生巨大的差异，或者只是迭代 2 或 3 次而不接受第一个结果。

而且工具也会变得更好。

children.author: Planktonne
children.textRawHtml:
> especially hard to explain it to the AI infatuated among us because they don't really want to understand why people dislike the tooling they're obsessed with

Your comment is an example of what the parent comment is discussing; the reflexive "you can't really tell and anyway you can do it better to stop people being able to tell and also soon it will be better so no one will be able to tell" is a gallop like the narcissist's prayer.

People are telling you they can tell, and that they do care. The toupee fallacy works because there are good wigs that no one can identify unless told, but the idea that that there's actually brilliant AI prose (that no one has detected) always lacks examples.
children.textZhHtml:
> 特别难以向我们中迷恋的人工智能解释这一点，因为他们并不真正想理解为什么人们不喜欢他们所痴迷的工具

您的评论是父评论正在讨论的一个例子；反射性的“你真的无法分辨，无论如何你可以做得更好，阻止人们能够分辨，而且很快就会变得更好，这样就没有人能够分辨”，这是一种像自恋者的祈祷一样的疾驰。

人们告诉你他们可以分辨，而且他们确实在乎。假发谬论之所以有效，是因为有些好的假发除非被告知，否则没人能识别，但认为实际上存在出色的人工智能散文（没有人发现）的想法总是缺乏例子。

children.author: zenoprax
children.textRawHtml:
"AI Slop" seems to be misunderstood despite its simplicity: "this is sloppy/low-effort/unskilled work ... enabled by generative AI tools".

> "People are telling you they can tell, and that they do care."

In the same spirit, one could argue that "AI Slop" is actually constructive feedback to a small degree. It's a short-hand for "this is sloppy/low-effort/unskilled work with obvious utilization of generative AI tools". It's not much different than using the same photography filter for every post on Instagram or picking the most popular Wordpress theme --- if you are expecting praise for that then you will be disappointed.
children.textZhHtml:
“AI Slop”尽管简单，但似乎被误解了：“这是由生成式 AI 工具实现的马虎/低努力/不熟练的工作......”。

>“人们告诉你他们可以告诉你，并且他们确实关心。”

本着同样的精神，人们可以认为“AI Slop”实际上是一种小程度的建设性反馈。这是“这是一项草率/省力/不熟练的工作，明显利用了生成式人工智能工具”的简写。这与在 Instagram 上为每个帖子使用相同的摄影滤镜或选择最受欢迎的 Wordpress 主题没有太大区别 --- 如果您期待对此的赞扬，那么您会感到失望。

children.author: XenophileJKO
children.textRawHtml:
The biggest mistake is thinking that your aesthetics are "correct".

You make it a personal slight when you espouse, that your aesthetic preferences are universal and then farther malign people with different preferences by saying that they are not aesthecticly minded.
children.textZhHtml:
最大的错误是认为自己的审美是“正确的”。

当你拥护自己的审美偏好是普遍的时，你就将其视为个人的蔑视，然后进一步诽谤具有不同偏好的人，说他们没有审美意识。

children.author: ToucanLoucan
children.textRawHtml:
> The biggest mistake is thinking that your aesthetics are "correct".

Good thing I didn't say that then.

> You make it a personal slight when you espouse, that your aesthetic preferences are universal and then farther malign people with different preferences by saying that they are not aesthecticly minded.

Aesthetics are just taste and taste is subjective and will vary by person. That said you can, broadly, achieve "good" or "bad" aesthetics based on opinions at scale. The predominant opinion right now is that AI art is bad. You feel what you feel about that, but numerous prominent people, numerous companies who provide services, etc. are all responding to the fact that people find AI art ugly in a variety of ways. Any stock photo site I use has an option to filter AI art, and if it doesn't I don't use it. Projects in the public space that are outed for using it get backlash. Various social media sites are demonetizing generated content.

And to be clear, me saying people are not aesthetically minded is not meant as an insult. Plenty of people I respect do not care how shit looks or feels. But they are a minority in my experience, and frankly, anyone working in an even remotely creative field probably does care. YMMV.

Be that as it may, though, aesthetics do matter to a lot of people, even if they don't discuss it openly or lack the vocabulary to do so. People will say it just "feels wrong," or it's "soulless." It seems to activate our brains very similarly to things deep in the Uncanny Valley, where it looks allllmoooost right, but then fumbles something subtle in a way that makes it off-putting in retrospect.
children.textZhHtml:
> 最大的错误是认为你的审美是“正确的”。

还好我当时没有这么说。

> 当你拥护你的审美偏好是普遍的时，你就将其视为个人的蔑视，然后进一步诽谤具有不同偏好的人，说他们没有审美意识。

审美只是品味，品味是主观的，会因人而异。也就是说，从广义上讲，您可以根据大规模的意见来实现“好”或“坏”的美学。现在的主流观点是人工智能艺术很糟糕。你对此有什么感受，但许多知名人士、众多提供服务的公司等都在以各种方式回应人们认为人工智能艺术丑陋的事实。我使用的任何库存照片网站都有一个过滤人工智能艺术的选项，如果没有，我就不会使用它。因使用它而被曝光的公共空间项目会遭到强烈反对。各种社交媒体网站正在将生成的内容非货币化。

需要明确的是，我说人们没有审美意识并不是一种侮辱。很多我尊敬的人并不关心狗屎的外观或感觉。但在我的经验中，他们只是少数，坦率地说，任何在远程创意领域工作的人都可能会关心。 YMMV。

尽管如此，美学对很多人来说确实很重要，即使他们没有公开讨论它或缺乏这样做的词汇。人们会说它“感觉不对”，或者“没有灵魂”。它激活我们大脑的方式似乎与恐怖谷深处的事物非常相似，在那里它看起来完全正确，但随后却以一种令人反感的方式摸索了一些微妙的东西回顾一下。

children.author: elictronic
children.textRawHtml:
If it looks like cheap generic crap it’s probably cheap generic crap. Most AI imagery looks like cheap generic crap.

It’s flooded the market to the point average users are starting to turn away. Look different or be relegated to obscurity.
children.textZhHtml:
如果它看起来像廉价的普通垃圾，那么它可能就是廉价的普通垃圾。 大多数人工智能图像看起来都像是廉价的通用垃圾。

它已经充斥市场，以至于普通用户开始转身离开。 看起来与众不同，否则就会变得默默无闻。
